title: The Third Path
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji's words fell, an ancient and majestic voice rang out from the depths of the Source of Destiny—the voice of the Ultimate Chessmaster Cang Yutian, announcing that this ten-thousand-year chess game had finally entered its final stage.

text.content:
The ink of destiny flowed slowly through the void. The robed figure—the Destiny Scribe—concealed in chaos, only that ink-black brush in their hand radiated a chilling light.

Chen Ji stood in place, fingertips hovering over that turning point of destiny, yet no longer moving forward. Slowly lifting his head, his gaze pierced through the chaos like a blade. A mocking curve formed at the corner of his lips. "So this is your true purpose? Making me choose between inheritance and destruction, so you can comfortably continue using me as your chess piece?"

dialogue.content: The Destiny Scribe remained silent for a moment, then gently tapped the void with that brush, revealing a blurred image—scenes from ten thousand years ago, a figure bearing a striking resemblance to Chen Ji standing in the same position.

text.content:
"The Chen family ancestor from ten thousand years ago," the voice emerged from the chaos, devoid of any emotional fluctuation, "when he stood here, he chose inheritance. He passed down the secrets of the Tianji Record, waiting for someone capable of completing the final chess game. And you are the only existence in ten thousand years to have reached this step."

Chen Ji coldly laughed, yet the flames of fury in his eyes burned more intensely. "So in your eyes, I'm merely a tool to complete his unfinished work? From the moment I was born, was every detail of my life arranged by you?"

dialogue.content:
The Destiny Scribe's brush tapped again, the blurred image shifting to show Chen Ji's experiences over the years—being trampled as worthless, each calculated victory he orchestrated, every night he gritted his teeth through despair.

"Your choices have always been your own." The voice remained impassive. "I merely deliver the appropriate information at the appropriate moment. How you respond is your own concern."

text.content:
Chen Ji's hands slowly clenched into fists, his knuckles whitening from the strain. He stepped forward, confronting the figure in the chaos, his indignation finally erupting like a volcanic eruption. "My choices? Hah hah hah—"

He laughed maniacally, his voice echoing through the Source of Destiny, yet carrying an icy, razor-sharp edge.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji abruptly raised his hand, pointing at the blurry image of his ancestor from ten thousand years ago, his voice hoarse but each word cutting like a blade: "He chose inheritance because he wanted to use his bloodline to complete this chess game! He 'gave' me the right to choose, yet set the ending long ago—forcing me to pick between inheritance and destruction, just so this ancient grand design could keep running!"

His eyes blazed with anger and contempt. "What kind of choice is that? This is clearly forcing me to be a puppet!"

text.content:
The Source of Destiny fell into absolute silence.

The figure within the chaos seemed to be observing Chen Ji intently. After a long moment, it let out a slight sigh—a sigh that unexpectedly carried a trace of subtle appreciation.

"You're right." The Destiny Scribe's voice underwent its first subtle change. "The layout from ten thousand years ago did indeed have its limitations. He gave you the right to choose, but couldn't alter the rules of the chessboard itself."

dialogue.content:
The brush gently tapped again, and a new light appeared in the blurred vision—a rune Chen Ji had never seen before, emanating an aura distinctly different from the Tianji Record.

"But have you considered," the voice slowly arose, "that between inheritance and destruction, there might exist a third path?"

text.content:
Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply.

He stared fixedly at that rune, his mind racing at lightning speed. That runic energy... it belonged neither to the inheritance of legacy nor to destruction's ending, but to something more primordial, more fundamental.

"You're saying..." His voice trembled slightly, not from fear, but because a certain wild idea was taking shape in his mind.

"The third path," the Destiny Scribe's voice seemed to drift from an extremely distant place, "is neither inheritance nor destruction. Rather—"

"A complete rewrite." Chen Ji took over, his eyes burning with mad radiance, "Neither inheriting his chess game nor destroying the Tianji Record, but completely erasing all of this—including you, the ten-thousand-year chessmaster—and rewriting the rules of destiny from the very root!"

dialogue.content:
His voice echoed through the Source of Destiny, carrying unwavering resolve. "You say I'm a chess piece? Fine, then today I will overturn this entire game! No one will ever manipulate my fate—not you, not that so-called ancestor from ten thousand years ago, not this entire damned Heavenly Way!"

His eyes gleamed with unprecedented brilliance—the radiance born from madness and wisdom intertwining when driven to the brink.

text.content:
A sudden violent wind erupted within the Source of Destiny, and for the first time, the figure in the chaos retreated half a step.

"You're insane." The Destiny Scribe's voice finally carried emotional fluctuation. "The power needed to rewrite destiny's rules far exceeds your imagination. You have no idea what that means—"

dialogue.content:
"I don't know?" Chen Ji burst into mad laughter. "Of course I don't know! But I know one thing—ever since I was stepped on in the Servants' Quarters, I've had enough of this fate being manipulated by others!"

He stepped forward, staring directly at the figure in the chaos, his eyes filled with determination. "I don't know what rewriting the rules requires, but I know this—if I don't take the gamble, I'll only ever be your chess piece for the rest of my life! Since death is inevitable either way, why not fight for a possibility no one has ever achieved?!"

text.content:
That runic light suddenly blazed even more brilliantly, as if sensing Chen Ji's resolve. Within the Source of Destiny, countless laws began to vibrate and interweave, an unprecedented transformation quietly brewing.

The Destiny Scribe's form slightly wavered within the chaos, the light on that brush flickering uncertainly. "Are you truly determined to take this path?" The voice carried an unprecedented solemnity. "Once begun, there is no turning back. Are you certain you won't regret this?"

The figure in the chaos slowly raised their hand, that brush pointing at Chen Ji, the light at its tip more brilliant than ever before. "Since you have such resolve, let me see—if you truly have the qualification to walk this unprecedented path!"

Just as Chen Ji was about to touch that rune—

"Enough."

An ancient and majestic voice abruptly rang from the deepest part of the Source of Destiny, like the whisper of an ancient god, causing the entire space to tremble. The might contained within that voice was ten thousand times greater than any existence Chen Ji had ever encountered!

The Destiny Scribe's form abruptly stopped, the light on that brush instantly dimming. "...Cang Yutian?"

dialogue.content:
A massive phantom slowly formed in the depths of the Source of Destiny—an existence beyond words to describe—its form shrouded in endless starlight, its eyes like two scorching suns, radiating light that illuminated ten thousand years.

"The Ultimate Chessmaster Cang Yutian..." the voice echoed within the Source of Destiny, "after ten thousand years, you finally deign to reveal yourself?"

text.content:
That ancient voice rang out again, this time even clearer, as if whispering directly into Chen Ji's ear: "Brat, your audacity exceeds my imagination."
